record.paper_title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
record.original_question: Does there exist a topological property p of T0 spaces that is weaker than sobriety for general T0 spaces but equivalent to sobriety when restricted to Scott spaces Sigma P of directed complete posets P?

evidence.quote: Question 4.10. Is there a topological property p which is weaker than the sobriety for general T0 topological spaces but equivalent to the sobriety for Scott spaces of dcpos?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Recall that a topological space $X$ is $T_0$ if for any two distinct points there is an open set containing exactly one of them. The specialization preorder on a $T_0$ space is defined by $x \le y$ iff $x \in \overline{\{y\}}$. A nonempty closed set $C \subseteq X$ is irreducible if whenever $C \subseteq A \cup B$ with $A, B$ closed, then $C \subseteq A$ or $C \subseteq B$. A $T_0$ space $X$ is sober if every irreducible closed subset of $X$ is the closure of a unique singleton.

A poset $(P, \le)$ is a directed complete poset (dcpo) if every directed subset has a supremum in $P$. A subset $U \subseteq P$ is Scott open if (i) $U$ is an upper set (i.e., $x \in U$ and $x \le y$ imply $y \in U$) and (ii) for every directed subset $D \subseteq P$ with $\sup D \in U$, one has $D \cap U \neq \emptyset$. The collection of Scott open sets forms a topology on $P$, called the Scott topology, and the resulting space is denoted $\Sigma P$.

Question: Does there exist a topological property $\mathbf{p}$ defined on the class of $T_0$ topological spaces such that:
(a) every sober $T_0$ space has property $\mathbf{p}$, but some non-sober $T_0$ space also has property $\mathbf{p}$ (so $\mathbf{p}$ is strictly weaker than sobriety on $T_0$ spaces), and
(b) for every dcpo $P$, the Scott space $\Sigma P$ has property $\mathbf{p}$ if and only if $\Sigma P$ is sober?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of finding a topological property strictly weaker than sobriety on general $T_0$ spaces that coincides with sobriety on Scott spaces of dcpos appears to remain open. Well-filteredness is a natural candidate weaker than sobriety, but Kou's counterexample and later simpler examples show there exist dcpos whose Scott space is well-filtered but not sober, so well-filteredness does not satisfy the requirement. Recent literature on sobriety of Scott spaces continues to investigate related characterizations without resolving this question.

status_evidence.title: On two problems about sobriety of topological spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Addresses open problems concerning sobriety of topological spaces, in the same line of research.
status_evidence.claim: Sobriety questions for Scott spaces of dcpos remain actively studied with several problems still open.

status_evidence.title: A new dcpo whose Scott topology is well-filtered but not sober
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs a dcpo whose Scott topology is well-filtered but not sober.
status_evidence.claim: The natural weaker property of well-filteredness does not coincide with sobriety on Scott spaces of dcpos, so it does not answer the question.
